product_overview: CallWaiting AI is an interactive chat widget integrated with OpenAI GPT-4 and MiniMax Text-to-Speech (TTS) technology, designed to provide intelligent, real-time conversational experiences via text and voice. It serves as a sophisticated AI receptionist that can handle inbound conversations, offering users natural language interactions enhanced with voice responses.
core_goals: Deliver a seamless and responsive chat experience with both text and voice interaction modes.
Integrate advanced AI intelligence using OpenAI GPT-4 to generate context-aware, professional, and concise responses.
Incorporate high-quality TTS voice generation to provide natural and engaging audio replies.
Enable easy deployment and configuration through n8n workflow integration with detailed setup and troubleshooting guides.
Ensure robust security through API key management, rate limiting, and secure communication protocols.
Provide comprehensive testing tools and documentation to support development, deployment, and debugging.
key_features: Floating chat bubble button to initiate conversations.
Expandable chat window supporting text input and voice recording modes.
Real-time text chat interface with instant AI-generated responses and loading indicators.
Voice chat interface featuring microphone toggling, recording timers, and speech recognition.
Automatic playback of AI-generated audio responses using MiniMax TTS with configurable voice options.
Integration with n8n workflows for webhook processing, AI response generation, and TTS audio production.
Extensive documentation covering quick start, workflow setup, troubleshooting, technical details, and production deployment.
Testing utilities including command-line webhook tester and local server for UI testing.
Security features including environment variable usage, CORS restrictions, rate limiting, HTTPS enforcement, and input validation.
user_flow_summary: User opens the website and sees the floating chat bubble button.
User clicks the bubble to expand the chat window.
User types a message or toggles voice mode to record a voice message.
If voice mode is used, the user records and sends a voice input.
The message or voice input is sent as an HTTP POST to the configured n8n webhook endpoint.
The n8n workflow processes the input, invokes OpenAI GPT-4 to generate a text response, then calls MiniMax TTS API to generate an audio response.
The chatbot receives the AI text and audio URL, displaying the text response and auto-playing the audio reply.
User continues conversation with either text or voice inputs seamlessly.
Testing can be performed locally using provided commands and UI, and deployments follow documented guidelines.
validation_criteria: Chat bubble and chat window UI load and function correctly without errors.
Text messages can be sent and AI responses are received within 3 seconds on average.
Voice recording starts, stops, and sends correctly, with audio responses played back automatically.
Webhook integration returns valid JSON with 'text' and 'audio_url' fields as expected.
AI responses are relevant, context-aware, professional in tone, and concise (~100 words).
Security measures such as API keys security, CORS, rate limiting, and HTTPS are properly enforced.
All setup and troubleshooting guides lead to successful configuration and deployment.
Testing tools pass all tests including webhook test scripts and UI functionality.
Production deployment complies with recommended security and performance guidelines.
User experience is consistent across browsers and devices, including mobile responsiveness.
